text:
Alex Chen: Montclair legal sent final POC preflight. They want API compatibility (route names + streaming), security answers, and a capped trial. Can someone own the mapping doc?
Priya Rao: I'll own mapping + prompt parity. Plan: 500 canonical prompts across 8 intents. Will normalize whitespace and punctuation before diffs.
Javier Morales: I'll build a lightweight compat shim that accepts Montclair-style endpoints and proxies to Redwood. It will: map model names, emulate 202/poll behavior, and preserve streaming envelopes.
Sophie Li: Security items: TLS1.3, customer-managed KMS for Private, logs retention policy (30d default), webhook signing. I'll fill questionnaire and mark any enterprise exceptions.
Alex Chen: Pricing: propose $7k trial credit with alerting and a 5 RPS soft throttle. @Priya add an acceptance threshold for top-1 parity.
Priya Rao: Draft acceptance: top-1 exact match >= 80% after normalization OR semantic similarity >= 0.9 for remaining. Latency median < 150ms for 256-token baseline.
Javier Morales: Quick curl examples for shim (poll and stream):
# stream flow
curl -X POST https://compat.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"montclair-large","prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream'
# poll flow
curl -X POST https://compat.redwood.internal/v1/async -d '{"model":"montclair-long"}' -H 'Idempotency-Key: qwe'

Priya Rao: I'll run initial 500 prompts after Javier posts the shim image to staging.
Sophie Li: Uploaded answers to sec-bot link. Left 2 infra TODOs on KMS onboarding and webhook IP ranges.
ops-bot: Tasks created: "deploy compat shim to staging" assigned to Javier; "run prompt harness" assigned to Priya.
Alex Chen: Action items recap: Javier push shim image + curl examples; Priya run parity harness; Sophie finalize security doc; I'll follow up on trial credit MSA. Kickoff Wed if legal signs.
Priya Rao: Noted. If parity fail rate >20% escalate to ML tuning.
Javier Morales: Pushing shim to registry: registry.redwood/staging/montclair-shim:v0.1. Smoke at 2pm PT tomorrow.
Alex Chen: Good progress. Keep thread updated.
note: sales presales thread coordinating Montclair->Redwood compatibility POC: owners, shim sketch, acceptance criteria, security questionnaire, and trial credit
